about: US-SPEC-01 section 4.2: the L2 records and the seed tables that hold them. The specification's column names are illustrative and the roles of the tables are normative (US-00-R06), so this file is the published mapping. l1.test.js applies every module migration and fails if a table named here is missing. A record with no seed table is listed under missing with the reason.

missing.program_focus_log: kernel_focus holds the current focus set with the tick that wrote it; no table keeps the history of earlier sets
missing.model_task_matrix: the model for each kind of task is configuration read by core/router (router.rungs and providers), not a stored table
